# Forbidden
These pages were bound at the back of the book, away from the rest. They are out of order. They were not put here to be read in order.
The longer you read them, the less the book agrees with itself. Close it and open it again if the letters start to move.
- [textlink="The Monolith" link="WFLoreMonolith"]: black stones that give, and what they take back. - [textlink="The Unmooring" link="WFLoreUnmooring"]: where the world stops agreeing with itself. - [textlink="The Lattice" link="WFLoreLattice"]: the six anchors that hold it back. - [textlink="The Choir" link="WFLoreChoir"]: those who heard the song out past the anchors, and answered it.
